exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) group
outcome: Contribution of each TGCS group to overall CS rate
cohort: Women who gave birth at a tertiary care center in Turkey between January 1, 2011, and December 31, 2014
finding: The overall CS rate increased significantly between 2011 and 2014, with the largest contribution to this increase coming from the TGCS Group 5 (previous CS, singleton, cephalic, term gestation).
